Every accepted topology transaction now arms an invariant check at journalCommit/journalStep that runs at the next meshActionDrain — deferred because loop cut settles its range table after committing; the commit-time draft false-alarmed unowned=16/32 on a healthy chain, caught headlessly. The check gathers the full displayed+hidden partition, runs the existing mesh_journal_log.analyze prover, heals only what is provable (req_3032 overlap renormalize, compactOccupiedPartRanges for stale empty declarations), and reports every fault on BOTH surfaces: a [mesh-integrity] stderr line naming the guilty op plus a new integrity_alert action event (append-only ordinal 26) that AppFrame's drain loop answers by resyncing all mirrors from host truth (new ModelToolApi.resyncFromHost) and setting a visible warning status. Verified on the user's exact repro chain (cube, 2-axis loop cuts, extrude, mirrored nudges, merge, add cylinder, undo/redo): zero false alarms, partition OK, Add works; nativeMeshEvents bridge test 5 assertions pass; docs/game/editor_mesh_integrity.md + _index record added.
